title: Record the slot width of a nonnegative convolution
body:
## Summary
- The largest overlap of two length-`n` nonnegative sequences with coefficients below `2^a` and `2^b` is `n(2^a-1)(2^b-1)`, which is strictly below `2^{a+b+ceil(log2 n)}`.
- The bound holds on all 25,600 triples with bit lengths at most 20 and lengths at most 64.
- All 79,604 sequence pairs with bit lengths 1 or 2 and length at most 4 stay inside that half-slot. The selected κ is unchanged.
